title: PFHxS is predicted to bind KEAP1 and is associated with NRF2-NQO1 activation in hepatocellular carcinoma.
authors: He, Chenghao; Jiang, Jiaxin; Hou, Shuguang; Xu, Runchun; Huang, Qinwan
journal: Food and chemical toxicology : an international journal published for the British Industrial Biological Research Association
one_liner_zh: 该文结合分子对接与MD模拟预测PFHxS结合KEAP1并激活NRF2-NQO1通路，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作（NRF2转录因子）但核心是化学物-蛋白结合与通路激活，非TF-DNA结合机制建模，方法可迁移但对象偏离。
abstract: Perfluorohexanesulfonic acid (PFHxS), a prevalent short-chain per- and polyfluoroalkyl substance, has been implicated in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), but mechanisms remain unclear. We integrated transcriptomic analyses of The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) liver cancer cohort and an HCC single-cell dataset with molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations and in vitro assays to examine a PFHxS-relevant hypothesis involving KEAP1-NRF2 signaling. Across clinical datasets, higher NQO1, an NRF2-associated gene, was linked to adverse clinicopathologic features; NQO1-high tumor cells showed elevated NRF2-activity signatures and computationally inferred increased MIF signaling toward macrophages. Because exposure information is unavailable, these observations indicate association and define a PFHxS-relevant vulnerability axis rather than PFHxS-driven tumor states. Docking/dynamics suggested PFHxS can bind the KEAP1 Kelch domain near the NRF2-binding site. In HepG2 cells, PFHxS modestly increased viability/DNA-synthesis readouts and enhanced NRF2 nuclear localization, NQO1 protein abundance, and MIF secretion; pharmacologic NRF2 inhibition partially attenuated NRF2/NQO1 readouts and reduced MIF secretion. Together, the data support the hypothesis that PFHxS may engage a KEAP1-NRF2-related vulnerability axis, accompanied by NRF2/NQO1 pathway readouts and increased MIF secretion, motivating exposure-characterized and genetic studies to establish causality.
abstract_zh: 全氟己烷磺酸（PFHxS）是一种常见的短链全氟和多氟烷基物质，与肝细胞癌（HCC）相关，但其机制尚不明确。我们整合了癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）肝癌队列和HCC单细胞数据集的转录组分析，结合分子对接和分子动力学模拟及体外实验，检验了涉及KEAP1-NRF2信号通路的PFHxS相关假说。在临床数据集中，较高的NQO1（一种NRF2相关基因）与不良临床病理特征相关；NQO1高表达的肿瘤细胞显示出升高的NRF2活性特征，并通过计算推断出向巨噬细胞的MIF信号增强。由于缺乏暴露信息，这些观察结果表明关联性，并定义了一个PFHxS相关的易感性轴，而非PFHxS驱动的肿瘤状态。对接/动力学模拟提示PFHxS可结合KEAP1 Kelch结构域，靠近NRF2结合位点。在HepG2细胞中，PFHxS适度增加活力/DNA合成读数，并增强NRF2核定位、NQO1蛋白丰度和MIF分泌；药理学NRF2抑制部分减弱NRF2/NQO1读数并减少MIF分泌。综合来看，数据支持PFHxS可能参与KEAP1-NRF2相关易感性轴的假说，伴随NRF2/NQO1通路读数和MIF分泌增加，这促使开展暴露特征化和遗传学研究以确立因果关系。
